observations.explanation: The paper says AgentBench has eight environments, five newly created and three recompiled from published datasets (PDF p. 2), supporting the stated breadth through both new and adapted settings.
The paper evaluates 25 API-based and open-source models (PDF pp. 1, 3), and reports GPT-4 as best on seven of eight datasets (PDF p. 14).

The authors explicitly describe Aquawar as simplified and say they made adjustments to accommodate current LLM performance, including limiting fish types and staging game logic (PDF pp. 8–9). The observation appropriately limits what this setting establishes about the original game.

The paper describes GPT-3.5-turbo as the automatic LTP host and uses GPT-3.5-turbo-based answer extraction and checking (PDF pp. 9–10, 30–33). It also reports that automatic evaluation can be more tolerant than human evaluation for some measures and says it plans to improve the host (PDF p. 30). Thus the qualified concern about evaluator robustness and prompt choices is warranted as an open question, not a demonstrated defect.
